functions.name: base_ready_bonus_handoff_status_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.base_ready_bonus_handoff_status_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_alloc record;
  v_bonus public.base_ready_bonuses%rowtype;
begin
  if new.status is not distinct from old.status then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.status = 'ACCEPTED' then
    for v_alloc in
      select * from public.base_ready_bonus_allocations
      where handoff_id = new.id and status = 'RESERVED'
      for update
    loop
      update public.base_ready_bonus_allocations
      set status='RETAINED',updated_at=now()
      where id=v_alloc.id;

      update public.base_ready_bonuses
      set reserved_amount=round(greatest(0,reserved_amount-v_alloc.amount),2),
          retained_amount=round(retained_amount+v_alloc.amount,2),
          updated_at=now()
      where id=v_alloc.bonus_id
      returning * into v_bonus;

      perform public.base_ready_bonus_refresh_status_v1(v_alloc.bonus_id);

      update public.arka_pending_payments
      set handoff_note=case
            when v_bonus.remaining_amount <= 0.005 then concat('READY_BONUS_RETAINED:',new.id,'|READY_BONUS:',v_bonus.id)
            else concat('READY_BONUS_OPEN:',v_bonus.id,'|RETAINED_IN_HANDOFF:',new.id,':',to_char(v_alloc.amount,'FM999999990.00'))
          end,
          updated_at=now()
      where id=v_bonus.arka_payment_id;
    end loop;
  elsif new.status in ('REJECTED','CANCELLED') then
    for v_alloc in
      select * from public.base_ready_bonus_allocations
      where handoff_id = new.id and status = 'RESERVED'
      for update
    loop
      update public.base_ready_bonus_allocations
      set status='REVERSED',updated_at=now()
      where id=v_alloc.id;

      update public.base_ready_bonuses
      set reserved_amount=round(greatest(0,reserved_amount-v_alloc.amount),2),
          remaining_amount=round(remaining_amount+v_alloc.amount,2),
          updated_at=now()
      where id=v_alloc.bonus_id
      returning * into v_bonus;

      perform public.base_ready_bonus_refresh_status_v1(v_alloc.bonus_id);

      update public.arka_pending_payments
      set handoff_note=concat('READY_BONUS_OPEN:',v_bonus.id),
          handed_at=null,
          handed_by_pin=null,
          handed_by_name=null,
          handed_by_role=null,
          updated_at=now()
      where id=v_bonus.arka_payment_id;
    end loop;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
